text:
Draw a large spiral onto a piece of paper with 0 and 1 as shown.

In this game you have to place fractions along the spiral line between 0 and 1.

Players take it in turns to choose a fraction from the list below and write it on the spiral. Think about where the fraction would go on a straight number line from 0 to 1 and then use your estimation skills to work out where it belongs on the spiral number line you've drawn.

1/10, 4/10, 6/10, 5/10, 7/10, 2/10, 3/10, 8/10, 9/10

Further challenge: Where does 0/10 go? What fractions could go beyond the 1 if you extended your spiral number line?
